solution.approach: 85 In this work, we propose an efficient and accurate monocular 3D detection framework in single shot.

evidence.quote: 85 In this work, we propose an efficient and accurate monocular 3D detection framework in single shot.

Different from these approaches, our method predicts the nine perspective keypoints of a 3D bounding box in image space, and then utilize the geometric relationship of 3D and 2D perspectives to recover the dimension, location, and orientation in 3D space.
Training our method only uses the 3D properties of the object without the need for external networks or supervision data.

evidence.quote: Our method is the first real-time system for monocular image 3D detection while achieves state-ofthe-art performance on the KITTI benchmark.
• Evaluation on the KITTI benchmark, We are the first real-time 3D detection method using only images and achieves better accuracy under the same running time in comparing other competitors.
